workExperience.description:
Led the technical design and delivery of a mission-critical supply-chain platform for Arla Foods — one of Denmark's largest companies — solving an optimization and data-modeling problem that had remained unresolved for years despite multiple prior teams and significant investment.

As Technical Lead, I owned end-to-end system architecture, technical direction, and hands-on development, working closely with business stakeholders and a small core team. The data model had to support recursive production flows, per-site customization, and continuously evolving business rules.

Built with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Python (FastAPI + Strawberry GraphQL) on PostgreSQL with JSONB. Performance was tuned through deliberate data modeling, not UI shortcuts.

Within six months we delivered a working core that restored stakeholder confidence. The platform is now in production as a central decision-making system in Arla's supply-chain operations, reducing manual workload, improving visibility, and eliminating several sources of operational error.

Alongside the Arla work, I'm building agentic-first developer tooling for The Tech Collective internally — AI agent harnesses and CI/CD automations that embed LLM agents into the team's coding lifecycle, turning agent-driven development from ad-hoc usage into a structured part of how we ship.

Re-hired to engineer a comprehensive data warehouse, integrating data from various online channels and internal systems, several of which I had previously built.

The process began with in-depth interviews with department directors and managers to identify the most critical KPIs and metrics for the business. I then designed and implemented the warehouse in Google BigQuery, orchestrated through a suite of Node.js and Express.js microservices running on Google Cloud Platform.

The result made operational data accessible to leadership for the first time and supported the company's broader shift toward data-driven decision-making.

Developed backend solutions for custom Shopify platforms using Express.js and PostgreSQL, contributing to architecture discussions and sprint planning focused on scalability and forward compatibility.

Used Ngrok to expose secure test environments and Sentry to monitor and troubleshoot services in a microservices setup, which improved service reliability and issue resolution speed.

Hired as a consultant to drive digitalization initiatives, delivering custom software that automated operational workflows and reduced manual errors. One project increased operational efficiency by 66%, allowing the department to reassign two of three roles to other work.

For each project I worked closely with employees and managers to gather requirements, then designed flowcharts, mockups, and system architecture before validating with stakeholders. Implementations were built with Node.js backends and vanilla JavaScript frontends to stay compatible with the existing systems.

At Connexio, I was in charge of their new social media-driven recruitment product, overseeing both the technical and creative aspects of campaigns. Additionally, I designed operational processes and success metrics to boost project efficiency.
Although my primary role focused on managing marketing efforts within a small team, a significant portion of my responsibilities shifted towards technical development. I engineered a backend system using Node.js that seamlessly integrated with our CRM, leveraging Monday.com's GraphQL API. This system automated the addition of leads to the CRM and facilitated communication by sending emails and text messages through third-party software.

I founded and led a marketing consultancy, directing a team and managing a diverse array of projects, from SEO strategies to the development of automated marketing funnels and front-end design. My focus was on driving profitability and crafting customized solutions across various marketing disciplines.
The venture began during my medical studies and evolved into a full-time enterprise, prompting me to relocate my office to Bangkok and expand the team by hiring two employees. As the business matured, my role increasingly shifted towards technical responsibilities, including implementing marketing automation systems and optimizing conversion rates for landing pages using WordPress and React.
